# Python tooling for building and publishing the API reference site.
# The API reference Markdown itself is generated by TypeDoc (see `npm run docs:api`);
# MkDocs Material renders it into the published site and `mike` handles versioned
# publishing to GitHub Pages. Install with:  pip install -r requirements-docs.txt
mkdocs>=1.6.0,<2
mkdocs-material>=9.5.0,<10
mkdocs-awesome-pages-plugin>=2.9.0,<3
mike>=2.1.0,<3
